purpose: manage storage so data is durable, access is controlled, cost matches use, and capacity never surprises anyone
entry_criteria: Storage services and data owners are inventoried
procedure: Match storage type to need (block, file, object) and class to access pattern, with lifecycle rules that move or expire data.
Block public access by default, use policies tied to roles, and review access on a schedule.
Enable encryption at rest with managed keys, and versioning or object lock where recovery or immutability is needed.
Set backup or replication for important data, and test restoring a sample.
Monitor capacity growth and set alerts with enough lead time to act, and forecast from the trend.
Report cost per data owner, and remove abandoned volumes, snapshots and buckets after owner confirmation.
deliverables: storage inventory with owners and classes
acceptance_criteria: No storage is publicly accessible unless approved
Lifecycle rules exist for data with retention limits
Growth alerts give action lead time
validation_method: Cloud engineer and data owner review.

validation.check: restore ten objects or one volume snapshot from backup and compare checksums

failure_modes.response: Alert on growth rate and forecast

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A lifecycle rule moves log objects to a colder class after 30 days and deletes them at 400 days per policy; a monthly report lists 22 orphaned snapshots, 19 deleted after confirmation, and a restore of a sample volume matches checksums.
